facts.function: cover/housing protecting an electric motor controller

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8537 covers boards, panels and other bases equipped with apparatus for electric control; a motor controller falls there

Section XVI note 2(b): the covers are not goods of a specific heading of chapter 84/85 and are suitable solely or principally for use with the controller, so they go to heading 8538 (parts of 8535-8537); chapter 39 note 2 excludes articles of Section XVI

rejected_alternatives.reason: chapter 39 note 2 excludes articles of Section XVI; dedicated machine parts go to the parts heading
would apply only if the controller were a static converter (speed drive) of 8504.40; a motor controller is assumed to be control apparatus of 8537
the covers are molded parts, which have their own line 8538.90.60

missing_facts: Is the motor controller a control panel/apparatus of heading 8537 or a variable-speed drive (static converter) of 8504.40?
classification.rationale: Plastic covers designed for an electric motor controller are parts without their own heading, so Section XVI note 2(b) sends them to the parts heading of the host apparatus. Treating the controller as electric control apparatus of heading 8537, the covers fall in 8538, and as molded parts in 8538.90.60.00. N339672 classified a molded plastic enclosure for a motor-control PCBA in 8538.90.6000.
